CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-fly-mandate-revoke-guard, at head da12aa37dee15b9e9567bd6c848493436f2592dd. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch da12aa37dee15b9e9567bd6c848493436f2592dd for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-fly-mandate-revoke-guard, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-fly-mandate-revoke-guard <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-fly-mandate-revoke-guard; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
tools/pr/gh_comment.py imports its revoke pattern and MANDATE_GRAMMAR from tools/policy/budget_raise_gate.py (one definition, not a copy) and refuses an owner-account post to tvofi/heatpump_optimizer#201 whose body matches `revok` and names the id of a #201 comment carrying the MANDATE grammar, unless `--withdraw-mandate <id>` names that id. budget_raise_gate.py voids a mandate on any later owner-account #201 comment with `revok` plus the id as a whole number (case-insensitive, deliberately loose: over-revoking fails safe); a seat's prose posted as tvofi cost about 6 h of frozen mandated raises plus a new mandate. Null control in the self-test, five cases: 'decision 0012 is revoked; mandate 6175172275 still binds' is refused; the same with --withdraw-mandate 6175172275 posts; a body with `revok` and no mandate id posts; a mandate id with no `revok` posts; a non-#201 target posts. Stated gap, not built: a raw `gh issue comment` or `gh api` post bypasses the guard; comment-readback.md already makes gh_comment.py the posting instrument. Not code-owned (CODEOWNERS l.31).
